summary: ParaZero Technologies filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing a product demonstration of its DefendAir counter-drone solution at a defense exhibition in Romania. The filing contains no special situation event—no merger, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate action. It is a routine disclosure of business development and marketing activity by a foreign private issuer. The press release highlights attendance by NATO officials and military leadership but does not involve any transaction, board recommendation, or financial terms. As such, this is not a special-situation filing.
